target: Determine the exact shortest length L(12,3) of a cyclic binary sequence whose 12-bit cyclic windows cover every binary 12-word within Hamming distance at most3. Current source-bound interval, after independently checking the CPro1 witness:34 <= L(12,3) <=36.

definitions.sequence: A nonempty cyclic sequence (x_0,...,x_{L-1}) with x_i in{0,1}; all L starting positions count, and a length12 window may wrap around repeatedly if L<12.
definitions.coverage: For EVERY y in{0,1}^12, including both all-zero and all-one words, there exists j in{0,...,L-1} with sum_{k=0}^{11}[y_k != x_{(j+k) mod L}] <=3.
definitions.minimum: Minimum L over all such sequences. Do not assume existence is monotone in L without a proof.

primary_attestation.source: Chee–Etzion–Ta–Vu, Constructions of Covering Sequences and Arrays /2D-sequences, arXiv:2502.08424v2 (15 Jul2025), TableI p11; journal DCC93 (25Sep2025), Table1 p5456.
primary_attestation.quote: In Table I the current best lower and upper bounds on L(n,R) are presented.
primary_attestation.table_entry: n=12,R=3:34–40. Parent read the definition, TableI and sectionVIII. The table lower bound34 is an imported published finite lower bound unless re-proved here.
primary_attestation.later_upper_bound: Rosin/CPro1 result-12-3-36-seed1000.txt gives length36; parent independently tested ALL4096 target words, max nearest distance3, including both endpoints. Receipt cover12-3-parent-screen-v1/baseline-parent-result.json.

critical_source_verifier_warning: The public CPro1 problem_def.py uses range(0,(2**n)-1), omitting the all-one word. NEVER reuse this verifier. The parent independently verified its length36 sequence over all4096 words; the witness is valid despite this verifier bug. Also use modulo the ACTUAL sequence length, not an upper-bound parameter.
representation_plan: Freeze exact search/canonicalization before search. Start with a low-memory native C exhaustive or branch-and-bound search over necklaces/bracelets/complements, using bitset coverage and precomputed 12-ball masks (no per-candidate allocations); or a complete SAT encoding with native solver limits and independently checked UNSAT certificates. Every symmetry/pruning rule needs a completeness argument. Benchmark controls before projecting runtime; do not take the scout near-certain estimate as evidence.

acceptance.L34: An exact length34 covering sequence passing parent and two independent strict checkers, plus the imported lower bound34 (or a new full lower-bound proof).
acceptance.L35: A checked length35 witness PLUS a complete verified exclusion at34, with the lower bound34 imported or re-proved.
acceptance.L36: A complete verified exclusion at34 AND35, plus the parent-verified36 witness and the imported lower bound34.
acceptance.UNSAT_standard: Every exhaustive exclusion needs full coverage accounting, deterministic commands/source hashes, two independently written exact implementations or checked DRAT/LRAT over a proved-complete encoding, and positive/mutation controls. Timeout, heuristic miss or restricted-family miss is UNKNOWN.
acceptance.finite_witness_format: COVERING-SEQUENCE n R L on line1, then exactly L space-separated0/1 bits on line2, final newline; no unparsed data.
acceptance.scope: Settles one exact covering-sequence table entry only; not an asymptotic bound or an AI-value/major-breakthrough claim.

controls: Independently verify the CPro1 length36 sequence against all4096 target words.
Reproduce source TableI exact values L(9,3)=12,L(10,3)=16,L(11,3)=20,L(9,2)=20,L(10,2)=38 as calibration where affordable.
All-one endpoint negative control: n=1,R=0,L=1 sequence0 must be rejected; n=1,R=0,L=2 sequence01 must pass.
Cyclic-wrap positive (e.g. binary deBruijn 00010111 at n=3,R=0) and mutations; all bits/range/length/SHA checks fail for the intended reason.
resource_contract: <=4 CPU workers, <=8GiB, <=10GiB new disk; checkpoints<=30min, compute chunks<=3h; initial assay<=2 CPU-hours then continue only on a new bounded plan with measured rates; deadline2026-10-18T18:31:43-07:00. Set numerical-library thread limits explicitly.
permissions: No deletion, overwrite of frozen evidence, out-of-repo or /tmp writes, publication, external contact, commit/push, paid fallback, config or old-engine changes. Native solver limits or SIGTERM plus bounded wait only; NEVER SIGKILL or subprocess.run(timeout=...).
